idea: Handmade scented candles sold on Instagram, made in my hostel room

strategist.problem: The specific pain is the lack of affordable, aesthetically pleasing, and low-maintenance ambient lighting for small, cluttered hostel rooms. The exact moment the user feels it is late at night (11 PM - 2 AM) when they are studying or relaxing, the overhead fluorescent light is harsh and causes eye strain, and they cannot afford or fit a decorative table lamp or smart lighting system in their limited space.
strategist.target_customer: Female college students aged 19-22 living in hostels in Tier-1 and Tier-2 Indian cities, with a monthly pocket money of ₹3,000-₹5,000, who actively follow Instagram lifestyle and studygram accounts and purchase small, giftable items under ₹500 for room decor or self-care.
strategist.mission: To provide hostel students with affordable, hand-poured scented candles that transform their small living spaces into calming, personalized environments without requiring electricity or complex setup.

competitors.name: Local artisan candle sellers on Instagram (e.g., Delhi/Mumbai-based micro-brands)
competitors.differentiator: We win on price and relatability by pricing candles under ₹350 (vs. their ₹500-₹800) and using student-specific language and visuals that resonate with hostel life, rather than generic luxury aesthetics.

competitors.name: Mass-market candle brands on Amazon India (e.g., Bath & Body Works, The Man Company)
competitors.differentiator: We win on customization and local trust by offering small-batch, hand-poured candles with scents chosen by student polls, and by leveraging direct WhatsApp/Instagram community trust from batchmates, avoiding the generic, one-size-fits-all mass-market options.

competitors.name: DIY candle kits sold on Etsy or local craft stores
competitors.differentiator: We win on convenience and time by selling ready-to-light, finished products, saving students the 2-3 hours of setup, cleanup, and learning curve associated with DIY kits, which is critical for students with limited free time.

scope_cuts: No custom packaging or branded boxes in the first 30 days; we use plain kraft paper and handwritten labels to keep per-unit cost under ₹15 and avoid inventory waste.
No website or e-commerce platform; we sell exclusively via Instagram DMs and Razorpay payment links to eliminate hosting costs and technical setup time, focusing only on direct human interaction.

No expansion to multiple scent lines or colors; we launch with exactly 2 scents (Lavender and Vanilla) and 1 color (white) to minimize wax and fragrance oil inventory, reducing the risk of unsold stock.

stack.name: Instagram Business account
stack.why: Sole storefront per scope cut — DMs and catalogue only, zero hosting cost, matches where the target audience already is

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Order confirmation, shipping updates and repeat-buyer chats on the free app; no Cloud API spend until scale

stack.name: Razorpay
stack.why: Payment links for one-time UPI/card checkout without a website; 2% + GST only charged when a customer pays

stack.name: Shiprocket
stack.why: Lite free plan at ~₹45/shipment to ship candles pan-India from a hostel room

stack.name: Google Sheets
stack.why: Free order, inventory and pre-order tracker shared with a part-time batchmate helper

ai_tools.name: Claude
ai_tools.why: Writes DM scripts, product captions, handwritten-label copy and pre-order reply templates; Claude Code can cut and caption the pour-process Reel with ffmpeg

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Generates scent-poll poll questions, FAQ replies and Razorpay payment-link message drafts

ai_tools.name: Canva
ai_tools.why: Free plan for Instagram post templates, story polls and kraft-paper label designs

ai_tools.name: VN Video Editor
ai_tools.why: Free, no-watermark mobile editor for the 15-second candle-lighting Reel shot in the hostel room

mvp_features: SKU 1: 'Hostel Wind-Down' Lavender candle — 120g soy wax in a reusable glass tumbler, ~30 hour burn, kraft-paper sleeve + handwritten label, single wick
SKU 2: 'Midnight Library' Vanilla candle — 120g soy wax, same tumbler and packaging, single wick
Bundle: 'Room Reset Duo' — both scents together with a handwritten note card, sold via one Razorpay payment link

tool_costs.price_note: 2% + GST per payment, no setup fee or AMC. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://razorpay.com/pricing/
free plan, about Rs 45 per shipment on average. Price checked 2026-11-02 on https://www.shiprocket.in/pricing/

first_10_steps: Message 3 Instagram candle-supply sellers on Instagram and IndiaMART for soy wax, fragrance oil (lavender + vanilla), wicks and glass tumblers; get per-unit quotes for a 20-unit first batch
Order a ₹1,500 sample kit (500g wax, 2 fragrance oils, 10 wicks, 4 tumblers) and pour 4 test candles in the hostel room over one weekend
Post a 15-second pour-process Reel edited in VN Video Editor and a Canva carousel announcing 2 scents, tagging 10 studygram accounts you already follow
Open a Google Form pre-order for the 2 SKUs and the Duo bundle, cap it at 10 pre-orders, and share the link in your class and hostel WhatsApp groups
Collect pre-order payments by generating one Razorpay payment link per buyer and confirming each order in WhatsApp Business within 10 minutes
Buy the first 20-unit inventory batch (wax, 2 fragrance oils, 20 tumblers, wicks) only after 5 pre-orders are paid
Assemble kraft sleeves and handwritten labels for the 10 pre-orders; keep per-unit packaging under ₹15
Book the 10 pre-order parcels on Shiprocket Lite (~₹45 each) and hand them to the pickup agent from the hostel
Send a WhatsApp Business shipping-update message with the tracking number to each of the 10 buyers on dispatch day
Ask each delivered buyer for one WhatsApp testimonial and one Instagram story tag, then repost the best 3 on your Instagram grid before opening the next batch of 10 orders

Batch 2 of 10 opens after testimonials reposted; 4 buyers from batch 1 repeat-buy the Duo
Batch 3 + 1 hostel club/fest bulk order of 8 units; repeat rate held at ~30%

key_assumptions: Target buyer pays ₹299-₹549 for a one-time candle purchase; assumes willingness to pay under ₹500 for room decor as stated in the strategy brief (monthly pocket money ₹3,000-₹5,000).
Blended avg_revenue_per_customer of ₹349 assumes a mix of 60% single-candle buyers at ₹299 and 40% Duo buyers at ₹549.

delivery_cost_per_customer of ₹145 = goods + packaging (~₹100 for wax, fragrance, tumbler, kraft label at 20-unit batch scale) + ₹45 Shiprocket per shipment; assumes 1 shipment per paying customer per month.
Razorpay 2% + GST on ₹349 ≈ ₹8 per order is absorbed inside the ₹145 delivery cost, not billed monthly.

channels.name: Instagram Reels & Story Polls
channels.tactic: Post 3 Reels/day (pouring process, 15-sec burn test, 'hostel room before/after') with text overlay 'Hostel wind-down, no electricity needed'. Post 2 Story polls/day asking 'Lavender or Vanilla?'. DM every user who votes, comments, or shares the reel with the Razorpay link within 1 hour. Volume: 3 Reels + 2 Story polls + 30 DMs/day.

channels.name: Hostel WhatsApp Groups & Direct DMs
channels.tactic: Send a 3-line cold message to 50 female batchmates, hostel-mates, and seniors in private WhatsApp chats daily (not group broadcasts). Offer a free 20g sample candle to the first 10 who reply. Volume: 50 DMs/day.

first_10_customers: Day 1-3: Pour 10 candles (5 Lavender, 5 Vanilla) using ₹2,000 of the starting capital for soy wax, fragrance oil, wicks, and glass tumblers. Label them by hand on kraft paper.
Day 4-5: Send the 3-line cold message to 50 female batchmates and hostel-mates via WhatsApp DM. Explicitly offer a free 20g sample candle to the first 10 who reply, with no purchase required.

Day 6-7: Follow up with the 10 sample recipients. Ask them to light the sample and share a 15-second video of the flame in their room. Immediately offer to ship the full 120g candle for ₹299 if they like the scent, using a Razorpay payment link sent in the same chat.

Day 8-12: Post the 15-second sample videos as Instagram Stories with a 'Link in bio' CTA. DM every follower who reacts to the story with the direct Razorpay link for the ₹299 candle or ₹549 Duo bundle.
Day 13-20: Ask the 10 sample recipients to forward the Instagram post to 3 other female friends in their hostel. Track who clicks the link and DM them personally to close the sale.
Day 21-30: Ship the first 10 orders via Shiprocket. Include a handwritten note card asking for a 1-star Instagram tag. Use these tags in the next 3 Reels to drive the next batch of 10 pre-orders.
growth.cold_message: Hey [Name], I'm making small-batch scented candles in my hostel room for late-night study sessions. I'd love to send you a free 20g sample (Lavender or Vanilla) to see if it fits your space. No purchase needed, just want your honest take on the scent.

objections.objection: I don't have ₹299 for a candle right now.
objections.response: Totally understand. I can hold a spot for you in the next batch, or you can start with the ₹299 single candle instead of the ₹549 Duo. I also offer a 7-day no-questions-asked refund if the scent doesn't work for your room.

objections.objection: Will it smell too strong for a small hostel room?
objections.response: The 120g size is designed for 10-15 sq ft spaces. It burns for ~30 hours total, so you only need to light it for 1-2 hours a day. The soy wax burns clean without harsh chemical fumes, so it won't overpower the room.

critic.verdict: The plan stays true to the original idea — hand-poured scented candles sold via Instagram from a hostel room — with correct physical-product sourcing, samples, and campus-first channels. Pricing at ₹299-₹549 fits Indian student purchasing power and the bootstrapped budget, and the free-tool stack respects the hard rules. The main gaps are in growth execution realism and a couple of internal inconsistencies that could stall the founder.
critic.biggest_risk: The plan depends on converting strangers into ₹299-₹549 buyers through cold DMs and sample gifting with zero established trust or track record; if the free-sample funnel doesn't convert at a meaningful rate within the first 30 days, the founder burns inventory and time without revenue.
